verdict.rationale: Semgrep is a SAST tool that analyzes source code locally by default and never uploads it, and CLI scans can run fully offline/without an account (semgrep-gh-2, semgrep-probe-5, semgrep-probe-7), which inherently avoids touching production data. However, there is no explicit 'sandbox environment' feature for AI agents, and the one agentic integration point (MCP server) failed to handshake in a probe, undercutting confidence in a smooth AI-native sandbox workflow.
